Thanks for the ping. Legal can turn around a countersigned mutual NDA today if we use our standard gating language. Notes / recommendations:

1) NDA: I'll attach our mutual NDA (Redwood_NDA_OliveBank_v3.pdf). Redline highlights: mutual confidentiality, limited purpose clause (security review), 1-year retention prohibition on redistribution, and a secure-viewer only clause for privileged reports. We should insist on DocuSign countersignature and retain the executed PDF in our contracts folder.

2) Report redaction: Recommend providing a redacted copy (sensitive config/IP removed) for initial review and offering a secure-view-only session for privileged sections. If Olive Bank needs the unredacted report, require SOC2 access request form + signed legal agreement acknowledging no redistribution and a named viewer list.

3) Bridge letter: We can provide a bridge letter covering the gap months (Jan–Jun 2026) summarizing that no control exceptions were identified in the interim. Legal will draft a short attestation; procurement may want to approve final language.

4) Timeline: If we countersign NDA today (EOD), we can produce a redacted PDF and the bridge letter within 2 business days (target 2027-06-07). Full (gate-access) delivery can be scheduled for next week pending InfoSec review.

Decision items for Markus:
- Approve Redwood_NDA_OliveBank_v3.pdf for DocuSign
- Confirm whether to gate privileged sections behind our secure viewer or provide a heavily redacted PDF for initial delivery
